# ScribeCat 0.24.2

A small File Viewer selection-mode fix.

## Selection menu

When exactly two Markdown documents are selected in File Viewer, the **…** menu now includes the same quick actions as the right-click menu:

- **Open selected in split view** (desktop)
- **Open selected as tabs**

The commands remain hidden when folders are part of the selection or when the selection is not exactly two Markdown documents.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Reidar96/scribecat/compare/v0.24.1...v0.24.2
